title.orig: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher
title.en: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: Marquand Collection, Gift of Henry G. Marquand, 1889

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1675. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1675 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A young woman in a white linen hood and a blue skirt stands by a leaded window, one hand opening the casement and the other resting on a silver pitcher in a basin on a table covered with a red patterned rug. A map hangs on the pale wall behind her.
alt.zh: 一位戴白色亚麻头巾、穿蓝裙的年轻女子站在铅框窗边，一只手推开窗扇，另一只手搭在一把银壶上；壶放在盆里，桌上铺着红色花纹的毯子。她身后浅色的墙上挂着一幅地图。

note.en: Vermeer painted very few pictures, and many of them are this: a single person in a room in Delft, lit from a window on the left. The white hood holds blue and grey reflections from the glass and the wall. She is caught between two small acts, and the painting lets the moment stay open.
note.zh: 维米尔一生画作极少，其中许多就是这样：代尔夫特的一个房间、一个人，光从左边的窗子照进来。白色的头巾里映着玻璃和墙的蓝灰色。她停在两个小动作之间，而这幅画让那一刻一直敞开着。
